reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and date adjustment helpers, but the range handler independently implements daily occurrence eligibility.

duplication.why: Daily skipping policy is duplicated between getNextDate and getDatesInRange, and getNextDate repeats its filtering block for forward and reverse enumeration.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but daily skipping policy is split between that shared module and a server handler.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested scheduling features, their consumers, types, and tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate multiple occurrence policies and unexplained enumeration bounds instead of owning one shared occurrence-resolution definition.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts:getDatesInRange independently implements daily skipping and reconstructs the non-working-day predicate rather than sharing the policy implemented in shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange expresses daily skipping as a map-to-null branch with an inline weekend/holiday predicate, while getNextDate expresses the same policy through filtering and isNonWorkingDay.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate gains a daily-specific take ternary and two daily-specific filtering branches; getDatesInRange independently reimplements daily eligibility.
